pages.name: QGA: Classical, 6...a6 7.Bb3 cxd4
pages.notes: Overview called the structure symmetrical; plan 3 pushed d4-d5 with Black's pawn still on d4. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Classical, Rubinstein, 8.Qe2 cxd4
pages.notes: Overview spoke of an open d-file and plan 2 of a d5-pawn, neither of which exists. Rewrote overview and both plans around the isolated pawn after exd4.

pages.name: QGA: Classical, Spassky, 9.b3
pages.notes: Overview called the c1-bishop light-squared; plan 1 gave a minority attack with a4-a5 and wrote e5 as a move. Fixed both; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Classical, Spassky, 9.Nbd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 pressed a c5-pawn (it is a bishop); plan 3 routed Nf1-e3 with no knight on f1. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Classical, 7.Qe2 b5 8.Bb3 Nc6 9.Rd1 c4
pages.notes: Plan 1 challenged a d5-pawn Black does not have; plan 2 wrote White's e4 as a Black move. Rewrote both (Nc3 and e4; ...Bb7, ...Nb4 against c2); British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Accepted: Classical, Flohr Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 gave White the bishop pair after the c2-bishop was traded. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2 around 13.d5 and e4; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Classical, 8...Bb7 9.a4 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed a knight d2-b3-c5 into Black's c5-pawn; overview called the b7-bishop fianchettoed. Fixed both; British spelling.

pages.name: Diemer-Duhm Gambit (DDG): Alapin Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf3 after f3 and used 0-0 shorthand. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling, including French Defence.

pages.name: Diemer-Duhm Gambit (DDG): Keres Defence
pages.notes: Plan 1 lifted a rook from f1 to h3 through the f3-pawn; plan 3 used an open c-file that is closed. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: 3.Nf3 c6 4.Qc2 Nf6 5.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 2 named Moscow and Anti-Moscow lines that need Nc3 and wrote White's Bxf6 as a Black move. Rewrote it.
